description: Explain why the EVM arm-then-fire mint model does not port to Solana, with the real numbers. Covers: a signed transaction dies in ~60s because recent_blockhash is inside the signed message, so pre-signing ahead of a trigger is impossible; Solana has no nonce, so a re-signed retry can land ALONGSIDE the original and mint twice; and every minter writes the same candy machine account, capping a collection at roughly 12,000,000 CU per block network-wide no matter how many wallets are used. Read-only.

computeUnitsPerMint.description: CU per mint, to compute the per-block ceiling for the collection.

name: solana_mint_constraints
